Diwali is just around the corner! Don't worry, I'm here to help you prioritize your tasks. Considering you have a lot to do, let's break it down into manageable chunks. Remember, prioritize tasks based on your schedule and energy levels. Don't hesitate to ask for help if you need it, and enjoy the festive spirit of Diwali!
